generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder shall quote his rates Exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the last date of receipt of tender.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Drilling & grouting to body of Talakalale dam including reaming of body & foundation drains.

itemList.description: Under water identification of suction points, chipping / raking to the required depth, cleaning of joints by brushing / using pneumatic tools, filling of sand particles, fixing of nipples for grouting using necessary equipments and underwater plugging of suction points where heavy seepage is observed with cementatious non shrink, rapid setting, multipurpose compound, including cost of diving, video monitoring and communication, fixing of nozzles wherever required, cost of all materials, scaffolding, labour, machineries, etc complete with all lead and lifts as per the directions of Engineer in charge.

Colour video monitoring wherever directed including covering all activities viz chipping / raking to the required depth, cleaning of joints by brushing using pneumatic tools and underwater plugging of suction points, filling of sand particles, fixing of nipples using necessary equipments such as underwater video camera monitoring unit with surface TV set for display at top with reference to marking grids on the face of dam including cost of all equipments, labours, divers, colour video recording also should be done for a period of 20 hours covering the above activities wherever directed and delivery of 4 sets of recorded CD etc., as directed by Engineer in charge.

Drilling 40 mm to 50 mm diameter holes (non coring) by rotary method in rock, masonry or concrete including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides etc., complete with all leads and lifts (excluding cost of cement) (For Dam and Allied works) as directed by Engineer in charge (for primary, secondary and tertiary holes for cement grouting). Depth upto 15m from the surface
